title: Encryption evidence workflow & automated rotation metrics
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Goal: implement an end-to-end workflow that produces verifiable encryption evidence artifacts and exposes rotation health metrics for KMS/HSM-managed keys. This ticket covers: (1) standardizing the evidence artifact format (signed JSON manifest + attachments), (2) building an event-driven collector that ingests key lifecycle events from cloud KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) and on-prem HSMs, (3) implementing an automation pipeline that assembles per-key/per-customer evidence bundles and stores them in a locked, auditable bucket, and (4) publishing rotation and evidence-generation metrics to the Console dashboard and alerting on failures. This work must preserve HSM constraints (no key material export), support envelope encryption (DEKs + KEKs), and co-exist with existing rotation/audit pipelines. Deliverables: evidence producer lambda/operator, evidence manifest schema, Console metrics dashboard, runbook for on-call and rotation rollouts, backward-compatible migration plan for existing keys and aliases.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence manifest schema published and reviewed by Security and PM
Automated collector reliably ingests 95%+ of KMS/HSM rotation events within 15 minutes
Per-key evidence bundle produced for scheduled rotations and manual rotations and stored in secure bucket with ACLs/policy
Console dashboard shows daily rotation success rate, mean time to evidence generation, and failure reasons
Alerting created for evidence-generation failures exceeding 1% of daily rotations
Canary rotation test passes: automated evidence generated and validated for a test tenant without any application failures

Implement event ingest from CloudTrail/Cloud Audit Logs and HSM audit exports (SQS/kafka ingestion)
Build assembly service that correlates events and artifacts into signed bundles (use envelope encryption for stored artifacts)
Add metadata tagging and tenant correlation so evidence bundles are queryable by customer id and region
Create Console metrics pipeline: events -> metrics storage -> dashboard panels and alerts
Write runbook and on-call playbook for rotation failures and evidence inaccuracies
Add integration tests and a canary that performs rotation on test-key and validates bundle correctness
Document migration steps for rewrapping persisted DEKs when KEK rotates (zero-downtime strategy)
Coordinate with Legal/Compliance for evidence retention timeframe and redaction rules

implementation_notes: Prefer event-first design: treat rotation events as primary triggers and enrich with HSM logs and operator notes
Use envelope encryption: artifacts encrypted with DEK; DEK wrapped by KEK that is KMS-managed or HSM KEK. Store wrap metadata in manifest.
Rotation approach: non-destructive KEK rotation with DEK rewrap in background; rewrap operation should be idempotent and checkpointed
Evidence storage: versioned bucket with object lock enabled and restricted IAM to Compliance and on-call roles
Metrics: record 'evidence_generated', 'evidence_failed', 'evidence_latency_seconds' with customer and region labels
Binary attachments (audit snapshots) should be hashed and stored separately; manifest holds hash and reference to avoid embedding large binaries in JSON
Avoid exporting HSM key material; for on-prem HSMs only include signed HSM audit statements and vendor receipts in evidence bundles
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: rotation causes cache miss and transient latency spikes. Mitigation: staged rotations, cache pre-warming, and fallback alias mapping
Risk: incomplete event capture for on-prem HSMs. Mitigation: deploy a local shipper with guaranteed delivery (persistent queue) and end-to-end tests
Risk: evidence bundle contains sensitive data. Mitigation: automatic redaction pipeline and manual review gates for high-sensitivity customers
Risk: large volume of attachments increases storage/cost. Mitigation: configurable retention tiers and retention TTL per customer
